questions.text: What is intelligence? Compare and Contrast Spearman's Two factor theory and Thurstone's Group factor theory of intelligence.
Discuss the various research methods in cognitive psychology.
Describe the stages of creativity. Explain the relationship between intelligence and creativity.
Describe Haynes' model and Hall's model for effective problem solving. Discuss the perceptual, cultural and emotional blocks to problem solving.
Define aphasia. Differentiate between Broca's aphasia and Wernicke's aphasia.
Explain Atkinson and Shiffrin's stage model of memory.
Discuss the key issues in the study of cognitive psychology.
Explain the single-system versus dual-system hypotheses regarding acquisition of second language.
Discuss the strategies of problem solving and point out their advantages and disadvantages.
